title: Jonah in Nineveh
description: Jonah proclaims judgment over Nineveh. The city repents and God shows grace, but Jonah becomes angry.

versions.title: Jonah in Nineveh
versions.description: Jonah proclaims judgment over Nineveh. The city repents and God shows grace, but Jonah becomes angry.
versions.reason: [major] references: The proposal partially overlaps with the existing 'Jonah's Anger and God's Grace' (Jonah 4:1-11). However, the proposal also covers chapter 3 (the proclamation and repentance), which is not covered by the existing story. A merger would provide a more complete account of Jonah's mission in Nineveh.
